i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load issue #58, the superpowers brainstorming SKILL.md (reference), interrogator/triage/admiral SKILL.md seams, CONSTELLATION_OVERVIEW relationship contract, README artifact conventions. Record pass when loaded.

q1.title: Lifecycle position: who invokes shaping and when?
q1.imperative: Settle where the new capability sits: upstream of everything (human with a raw idea, before any issue exists), or also mid-stream (e.g. Commander understand step delegating to it). Governs skill audience and seam with Commander.
q1.finding: Upstream only: human invokes shaping directly with a raw idea before any issue/epic exists; confirmed spec feeds to-issues/Admiral; Commander understand step keeps Interrogator unchanged

q2.title: Seam with Interrogator: reuse the one-question survey engine or own dialogue?
q2.imperative: Settle whether shaping loads constellation-interrogator to drive its question phase (survey checklist through the engine) or carries its own lighter dialogue loop. Governs skill composition and engine usage.
q2.finding: Reuse: shaping's question phase loads constellation-interrogator and drives an engine survey (like Commander understand); shaping adds the creative framing (intent->approaches->design) around the shared one-question engine

q3.title: Skill shape: gated spine, survey, or checklist-free flow?
q3.imperative: Settle the workflow shape: a gated checklist (explore -> approaches -> design sections -> spec -> confirm), a survey, or checklist-free doctrine like Triage. Governs template set and engine ceremony.
q3.finding: Gated spine: small engine-driven gated checklist (~6 steps: context, interrogate(child survey), approaches, design, spec, confirm); confirm step is a user-decision postcondition = the mechanical hard gate; resumable

q4.title: Output contract: spec fields and durable path
q4.imperative: Settle the design-spec artifact: required sections (intent, approaches considered, chosen design, out-of-scope, confirmation record), the durable path convention, and what to-issues/Admiral consume from it. Governs the template.
q4.finding: Spec is NOT durable docs: lives in .agent-work (workflow state), used immediately (fed to to-issues/Admiral) or transcribed into an issue; the issue is the durable record, not the spec file

q5.title: Hard gate: how is 'no work cut from an unconfirmed design' enforced?
q5.imperative: Settle the enforcement mechanism: doctrine text only, a confirmation status field in the spec that downstream skills check, or an engine-checkable artifact. Governs acceptance criterion 3.
q5.finding: Engine gate + status marker: shaping spine confirm step requires user-decision evidence (engine-enforced); spec carries a Confirmation block (status/date/by); consumer doctrine: only consume a spec with a filled Confirmation block

q6.title: Approaches phase: mandate 2-3 alternatives with recommendation?
q6.imperative: Settle whether the superpowers-style 2-3 approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation is mandatory doctrine, and whether per-section design approval is carried over. Governs skill doctrine strength.
q6.finding: Both mandatory: always 2-3 approaches with trade-offs leading with recommendation; hardened design presented in complexity-scaled sections with per-section approval

q7.title: Naming and Admiral seam
q7.imperative: Settle the skill name (constellation-shaping vs constellation-brainstorm vs other) and whether a confirmed spec is formally named as pre-ruling material in the Admiral's launch-order/latitude doctrine. Governs install name and admiral doc touch.
q7.finding: Name: constellation-explorer. No Admiral doctrine touch: a confirmed spec may feed to-issues, go directly to a Commander, or be saved for later - downstream consumption stays flexible/informal this run

q4b.title: Transcription contract: what carries into the cut issues?
q4b.imperative: If the spec is ephemeral, settle what downstream consumes: full spec body transcribed into the issue(s), or a summary with the spec archived per normal work-id archive rules.
q4b.finding: Issue carries full spec: at closeout human picks route - (a) cut issues now, spec body incl Confirmation block transcribed into issue(s); (b) save for later, spec filed as a single shaped-design GitHub issue holding the full body. Issue tracker is the durable home; .agent-work copy archives per normal rules

q8.title: Excursion ramps: explicit off/on ramp for wider search
q8.imperative: Settle how research excursions (web, academia, prototypes) enter and exit the flow.
q8.finding: Explicit ramps required: the flow has a named off-ramp to dispatch wider-search excursions (web, academia, codebase, prototypes) and an on-ramp that returns findings into the exploration record

q9.title: Prototyping: in-skill excursion vs separate skill
q9.imperative: Settle whether prototyping ships as a separate skill this run, later, or folds into explorer doctrine. Reference: mattpocock/skills prototype (throwaway code answering a design question) and research (background agent, primary sources).
q9.finding: Build both this run: constellation-explorer AND a constellation-prototyper skill (Pocock prototype as reference: throwaway artifact answering one named design question, delete-or-absorb, only the answer survives). Explorer's excursion contract can dispatch prototyper

q10.title: Cyclic shape: point -> excursions -> consolidate, repeatable
q10.imperative: Settle the loop mechanics: how re-interrogation cycles are modeled in engine terms and who decides loop vs converge.
q10.finding: Spine + per-cycle surveys: explorer spine gates entry/exit (context -> explore(repeatable) -> spec -> confirm); each cycle its own survey cycle-N.json (point questions -> excursion dispatches -> consolidation of ideas); human decides at each consolidation: another cycle, converge to spec, or shelve

q11.title: Prototyper branches
q11.finding: Three branches: Logic (interactive TUI over pure portable module, Pocock-verbatim), UI (radical variants + switcher, Pocock-verbatim), Measurement (scoreboard metric + one-mechanism spike -> number on the board; matches global-orchestrator spike doctrine; the branch explorer wild-idea excursions mostly use)

q12.title: Prototype location
q12.finding: Split by driver: human-driven prototypes (logic TUI, UI variants) in-repo next to real code, clearly marked, one command to run; agent-driven excursion spikes (measurement, parallel wild ideas) in throwaway worktrees; the handoff states which

q13.title: Prototyper answer/cleanup contract
q13.imperative: Settle the output and disposition contract.
q13.finding: PROTOTYPE_HANDOFF (one named question, branch, host conventions, stop conditions) + PROTOTYPE_RESULT (answer, what it taught, surviving pure module if any, dispose/absorb recommendation) templates; result is the evidence artifact explorer consumes; prototyper closeout requires recorded disposition: deleted, absorbed (with commit), or parked-with-owner

q14.title: Critical spec review standard
q14.finding: Critical review of the spec is a STANDARD explorer spine step before confirm: dispatch a fresh-context critic (reviewer-style subagent) to adversarially review the spec - placeholders, contradictions, ambiguity, scope, unexamined assumptions, untested pathways; findings return to the human before the confirm gate

q15.title: Design-it-twice excursion
q15.imperative: Fold the Ousterhout/Pocock design-it-twice pattern into the excursion contract.
q15.finding: Design-it-twice is a first-class excursion type alongside research and prototype: 3+ parallel subagents each design the chosen approach interface under a distinct constraint (minimal interface / max flexibility / common-caller-first / ports-and-adapters), compared on depth, locality, seam placement, with an opinionated recommendation or hybrid. Spec design sections framed for deep, testable, tested pathways

q14b.title: Critic scope (revised)
q14b.finding: REVISES q14: Full adversary, nothing sacred - critic reads the spec COLD (no exploration record), attacks anything incl. deliberate decisions; human filters relitigation noise

q14c.title: Critic count/cadence
q14c.finding: Panel scaled by weight: default one cold critic; specs that spawn epics or touch architecture get a 3-lens panel (intent-fit / testability / simplicity-YAGNI); human can dial either way at the review step

q14d.title: Critic findings routing
q14d.finding: Human triages every critic finding: spec edit / re-open exploration (new cycle, possibly targeted excursion) / reject-with-reason; confirm gate only opens once every finding has a disposition

q15b.title: Design-it-twice placement
q15b.finding: BOTH: design-it-twice is available as a cycle excursion when interface shape IS the open question, AND standard at spec time for every load-bearing interface (3+ agents, distinct constraints, compared on depth/locality/seam/testability; trivial interfaces skip with stated reason)

q15c.title: Deep-module vocabulary blast radius
q15c.finding: Deep-module vocabulary (module/interface/seam/adapter/depth/leverage/locality, interface = everything a caller must know) goes STRAIGHT INTO GLOBAL DOCTRINE this run (_shared global-everyone.md) so every role speaks it immediately

q16.title: Anti-rush doctrine
q16.finding: Named doctrine: premature convergence is THE failure mode explorer exists to prevent. Mechanically: agent never initiates convergence; presents consolidated ideas + open threads, only the human says converge-to-spec; agent may flag ripeness but never in the same message as new findings

q17.title: Dogfood gaps: six run-discovered additions
q17.imperative: Fold in the gaps discovered by running the flow on itself.
q17.finding: All six adopted: (1) living IDEAS_BOARD.md artifact updated at every consolidation, spec crystallizes from it, resume reads it; (2) explorer starting-questions seed (itch, for whom, done-feel, what exists, what would make this pointless); (3) excursions human- or agent-initiated, same on-ramp; (4) slow excursion at consolidation = human call: wait or log as open thread into next cycle, never silently dropped; (5) mid-exploration shelve = file the ideas board as the shaped-design issue marked unconfirmed; (6) delta re-confirmation: after first pass present what changed, not the whole statement

q18.title: Scoped nulls + explorer optimism
q18.finding: Scoped nulls doctrine: a failed excursion/prototype verdict is scoped to THE SPECIFIC test/implementation that ran (this spike of X under conditions Y failed), never generalized to the approach class without evidence spanning it. Explorer posture is optimistic-persistent: keep trying variants rather than declaring impossibility - user has repeatedly had to coach agents past premature impossible verdicts. PROTOTYPE_RESULT answer field states what was and was NOT tested

q19.title: Spec template as bridge artifact
q19.finding: Explorer ships DESIGN_SPEC.template.md: ephemeral (not durable docs) but templated - the bridge between IDEAS_BOARD.md and plan building. Sections: intent; exploration record digest (cycles, excursion answers incl scoped nulls, rejected approaches with reasons); chosen design (interfaces in deep-module terms, per-section approval marks); testing pathways; out-of-scope; critic findings + dispositions; Confirmation block. Written so to-issues/Commander/Admiral can consume it directly

q20.title: Cycle flavors: shotgun / DIT-compare / refine
q20.finding: Three cycle flavors, human-picked at cycle start (agent may recommend): SHOTGUN - pure divergence, challenging idea count (default ~20, human-set), cheap one-liners, wild sanctioned, light excursions, consolidation clusters+culls with reasons kept on board; DIT/COMPARE - 2-5 candidates developed seriously with trade-offs, recommendation-led, excursions per candidate (prototype/measurement/design-it-twice), opinionated comparison, hybrid allowed - home of the superpowers 2-3 approaches pattern; REFINE - harden one direction, chase open threads, test load-bearing assumptions, tighten interfaces in deep-module terms, consolidation is spec-shaped. Arc shotgun->compare->refine->spec but flavors re-orderable/repeatable; a dead refine drops back per scoped nulls. Seed questions belong to first cycle only; later cycles seed from board open threads
